Name: JG BB8
Author: JGottwald
Description:
Changes your Cat or Dog into BB8 depending on which pet u picked.u can use both cat and dog file or just use the 1 you want to replace.[s]Also doesn't change audio so BB8 will sound and behave like a Cat or a Dog depending on what u picked in game.[/s]

EDIT: The new versions has a Wave Bank file that adds the BB8 sounds, simply copy/paste it into the XACT folder in Stardew Valley\content. If you rename the original (i.e. Wave Bank_OLD) you won't have to overwrite and can easily restore to the original.
You can choose between the default soundtrack and the one modified by Drogean called [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/85/?]More Music Mod[/url], both will have the BB8 sounds and pictures, the latter simply has added music to some parts of the game that were silent.
